description: 1 dim photo of a nightstand: a white-shade table lamp on a gold geometric wire base, space gray over-ear headphones lying on a black box with a white USB-C cable, a tall lavender insulated water bottle with a flex cap, a blue Chelsea FC plush, and a gray fabric tablet folio. Also 2 orange prescription bottles, a green supplement bottle, a white retainer case and a white Fujitsu air conditioner remote. The headphones and water bottle crops landed on the lamp base and a sliver of the bottle in the v2 Appraiser; the lamp and plush were missed.
